primary_endpoint: At week 72: resolution of steatohepatitis without worsening of liver fibrosis, and reduction in liver fibrosis without worsening of steatohepatitis.
efficacy_outcome: Resolution without worsening of fibrosis: 62.9% with semaglutide vs 34.3% with placebo (difference 28.7 percentage points; P<0.001). Fibrosis reduction without worsening of steatohepatitis: 36.8% vs 22.4% (difference 14.4 percentage points; P<0.001).
safety_signal: Gastrointestinal adverse events were more common with semaglutide.
